agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The Coppertop clone still ended in whiteout after 31 verified actions.

resolution.observed: The critical-bound and unsafe-fallback scorer fixes were replayed from turns 13, 15, and 26; each selected a different safer line and executed with no discrepancy. The unchanged losing bundle will not be retried.

findings.summary: At turn 13, Coppertop remained in front of Eelektrik at 35 HP with no critical-hit survival margin; a critical Shock Wave fainted it before Tackle could execute.

resolution.observed: Turn-013 replay selected healthy Birdlaw instead of staying with 35-HP Coppertop; the switch executed with no discrepancy under the critical bound.

findings.why_bad: The safety model used the normal incoming bound and did not reserve survival for a verified critical-hit bound.
findings.improvement: Score critical-hit survival before damage and switch when the active line cannot survive the conservative critical bound.

findings.summary: At turn 15, the policy switched full-HP Birdlaw into 6-HP Bushtank even though every candidate was unsafe; this donated an Eelektrik turn and created the later switch loop.

resolution.observed: Turn-015 replay selected the higher-margin Ohmnomnom fallback instead of 6-HP Bushtank; the switch executed with no discrepancy.

findings.why_bad: When no candidate was marked safe, raw outgoing damage outranked the active battler's much better survival margin.
findings.improvement: Use survival margin as the next lexicographic key and never prefer a catastrophically unsafe low-HP switch over a higher-margin active move.

findings.summary: Coppertop was a better reserve than Bugatti but was not yet a verified Eelektrik answer under the actual critical-hit line; the prepared team still lacked a certified safe continuation.

resolution.observed: Turn-013 replay verified Coppertop exits before its second Eelektrik reply, and turn-026 replay verified Croakatoa keeps Mud Shot rather than sacrificing the 4-HP Birdlaw reserve; both corrected actions executed with no discrepancy.

findings.why_bad: The team replacement was validated by one historical win but not against the current critical-survival requirement.
findings.improvement: Revalidate Coppertop's Eelektrik entry after the scorer fix, or prepare a different reserve/leveling plan before another clone.

findings.summary: 16 switches in 31 actions repeatedly traded a healthy active position for damaged reserves and did not close Eelektrik quickly.
findings.improvement: Preserve the highest-margin active battler and pivot only when the replacement's verified margin is better.

findings.summary: The line took 31 verified actions and consumed 16 switches before whiteout; speed is secondary until survival is repaired.

correct_choices: Spark removed Bibarel in two verified actions.
Bulldoze was used twice into Ponyta and Croakatoa finished Ponyta with Mud Shot.
Razor Leaf was used against Eelektrik and Coppertop entered with full HP.
Fake Out plus Sludge eventually removed Eelektrik.
Every one of the 31 action results and the terminal whiteout was RAM-verified with no tooling discrepancy.
agent_review.next_test: Run Clone 2 with the unchanged Coppertop opening and behavior hash fe9a7fa7; review all actions before any retry.
